tasks.fmtlint: deno task fmt && deno task lint
tasks.check: deno task fmt:check && deno task lint:check && deno task typecheck
tasks.build: deno task build:wasm && deno task typecheck && NODE_ENV=development deno run -A scripts/build-extensions.mjs
tasks.dist: deno task build:wasm && deno task typecheck && NODE_ENV=production deno run -A scripts/build-extensions.mjs
tasks.test: deno task build:wasm && deno test -A --no-check extension-loupe/test extension-allow-right-click/test extension-youtube-transcript/test
